Hazards and exit probabilities for new data from a survival model

dot-predict_survival_newdata.Rd

predict.survival_model() with newdata: one row per row of newdata (e.g. one per person), with the hazard of each exit type and, if every exit type is covered, the chance of each exit and of staying within horizon years.

Usage

.predict_survival_newdata(object, newdata, horizon)

Arguments

object

A survival_model.

newdata

A data frame with the panel's tenure column, its covariates and (if the model has year effects) its snapshot date column, or a lazy database table with them (collected).

horizon

Number. The years ahead the exit chances are for.

Value

newdata as a data.table with hazard_<type> for each exit type modelled (per year), and prob_retired, prob_other and prob_stay if both exit types were modelled or had no exits.

Details

The hazard is constant within a tenure band, so the chance of leaving within horizon is 1 - exp(-total hazard * horizon), split between the exit types in proportion to their hazards. This holds for any horizon (a month, a year, several), and the three chances always add up to 1.
